title: Data and code for: A Persistence-Controlled Evaluation of Stacked Ensembles for Sub-National Mpox Activity Classification
description: Reproducibility package: harmonised unit-month panel (2,835 unit-months, 72 units in DRC, Nigeria and Uganda), analysis code, stored predictions and result tables, and source-report manifests with SHA-256 hashes. The binary outcome is reported activity (new_cases_monthly > 0) and coincides with the coverage flag; see README.
